newsitem.title: USA: PSA recommends early U.S. market close on Friday.
newsitem.headline: PSA recommends early U.S. market close on Friday.

text.p: PSA, the Bond Market Trade Association, has recommended an early close at 1400 EST/1900 GMT for U.S. credit markets on Friday, February 14, the association said in a statement.
It also recommended a full close on Monday, February 17, for the celebration of the President's Day holiday.
PSA's requests for an early close are recommendations only. The association recommends that each member firm decide for itself whether its fixed-income departments will remain open for trading.
